data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Cache Engineering for Agents — Direct KV-Cache Control (append, drop, repos), Extended Radix Trees, and Prefix-Preserving Compaction
data.description: Deep-dive OKF specification on Cache Engineering for long-horizon AI agents (Fu et al., Tsinghua/CUHK 2026): decoupling active KV cache from logical token trajectories via append, drop, and RoPE repos operations, history-dependent state management in the AKV serving engine (Extended Radix Tree + Segment-Batch Attention), Tool-Response Rolling Drop, and Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI).
